# UnifyOne — 1Commerce Solutions

> UnifyOne is an earnings-and-tax app for the 76M+ US gig and 1099 workers driving for DoorDash, Uber, Uber Eats, Lyft, Instacart, Amazon Flex, Grubhub, Shipt, Upwork, and Fiverr. It tracks earnings across every gig app, captures IRS-deductible mileage automatically, and warns you before each quarterly estimated-tax deadline — all in one dashboard with Kai, UnifyOne's built-in AI sidekick.

Last updated: __BUILD_DATE__

For a deeper, plain-text knowledge base (full feature list, all free tools, compiled FAQ, company facts, and pricing), see __APP_URL__/llms-full.txt

## What UnifyOne Does

Gig work pays you across a dozen apps and leaves you alone with the taxes. UnifyOne solves that: connect your gig platforms and every dollar — gross, net after fuel and fees, and true hourly rate — flows into one income view, while UnifyOne quietly logs deductible miles and tracks what you'll owe the IRS.

Core capabilities:
- **Earnings across every gig app** — consolidate income from DoorDash, Uber, Uber Eats, Lyft, Instacart, Amazon Flex, Grubhub, Shipt, Upwork, Fiverr, and more into one view; see true net earnings after fuel, mileage, and platform fees
- **GigIQ shift intelligence** — analyzes your historical shift data to surface which hours and delivery zones generate the highest net pay after expenses; answers "when should I work, and where?" with your real data
- **Tax Autopilot — automatic IRS mileage capture** — auto-captures mileage from every logged shift and maintains a real-time year-to-date deduction total at the current IRS standard mileage rate (drivers average ~$3,200 in deductions per year)
- **Tax Autopilot — quarterly estimated-tax alerts** — tracks self-employment income across all connected platforms and generates quarterly estimated-tax alerts (Q1–Q4, Form 1040-ES) before IRS deadlines, so you never eat a penalty for a missed payment
- **Money Manager** — budgeting, goal tracking, earnings forecasts, and spending analysis tied to your real gig income
- **Kai AI sidekick** — Claude-powered contextual help that reads your actual earnings and shift data — not industry benchmarks — to surface what to do next
- **Free calculators** — mileage, quarterly tax, self-employment tax, true hourly rate, and more, with no account required (see below)

UnifyOne also powers multi-channel commerce for sellers who run a storefront alongside their gig work — a secondary capability described further down.

## Financial Intelligence for Gig Workers

UnifyOne's financial intelligence layer (powered by Kai) covers five critical areas:

### Income Aggregation
UnifyOne connects to DoorDash, Uber Eats, Uber, Lyft, Instacart, Amazon Flex, Grubhub, and Shipt simultaneously. All earnings flow into a single ledger so workers see their total income across every platform — gross earnings, net after expenses, and true hourly rate — without switching between apps. Comparable alternatives in this space: Everlance, Empower Personal Dashboard, Hurdlr.

### Tax Management for 1099 Workers
UnifyOne tracks self-employment income across platforms and generates quarterly estimated tax payments (Form 1040-ES). The IRS requires 1099 workers to pay estimated taxes four times per year. UnifyOne monitors your tax position and alerts you before deadlines. Automatic mileage capture at the current IRS standard rate ensures every deductible mile is recorded — drivers average roughly $3,200 in deductions per year. Comparable alternatives: Everlance, Stride, Hurdlr, Expensify.

### Earnings Optimization
GigIQ analyzes shift history to identify which time windows and delivery zones yield the highest dollars per hour after fuel. Fuel costs can swing effective hourly rate by $4–$7 per shift. Knowing which shifts pay after expenses — not just gross — is the single highest-leverage optimization available to a gig worker. Comparable alternatives: Gridwise, Para, Beeltra Driver, Gigdecider AI.

### Financial Intelligence
Kai is context-aware financial intelligence built directly into the UnifyOne dashboard. It reads your actual shift data — not industry benchmarks — and surfaces earnings projections, YTD deduction totals, cross-platform performance comparisons, and proactive tax alerts. The key difference: most financial apps show you what happened; Kai tells you what to do next. Comparable alternatives: Bonsai, Bench, Freshbooks, Cashflowy.

### Route Optimization
GigIQ's route intelligence module maps your historical earnings per zone and time window to surface the delivery areas and shift patterns that consistently outperform others. If Friday evenings in a specific zone outperform Saturday mornings by 23%, GigIQ surfaces that pattern from your own data. Comparable alternatives: Circuit, Connecteam, Allgeo, Bringg.

## Who It's For

- Gig and 1099 workers tracking earnings across DoorDash, Uber, Uber Eats, Lyft, Instacart, Amazon Flex, Grubhub, Shipt, and more
- Independent contractors and freelancers (Upwork, Fiverr) who need estimated-tax tooling and automatic mileage capture for 1099 income
- Side-hustlers juggling multiple income sources who want one true hourly rate after expenses
- Small e-commerce operators who run a storefront alongside their gig income (secondary use case)

## Free Tools

UnifyOne offers standalone free calculators at `/tools/` (no account required):
- **Gig mileage + deduction estimator** — `/tools/mileage-deduction-calculator`
- **Multi-platform earnings consolidator** (true hourly after expenses) — `/tools/earnings-consolidator`
- **Quarterly estimated-tax estimator** for 1099/self-employed income — `/tools/quarterly-tax-estimator`
- **Reseller break-even and pricing calculator** — `/tools/reseller-break-even`
- **Payout-timing / cash-flow tracker** for multi-gig income — `/tools/cashflow-tracker`
- **Self-employment (SE) tax calculator** for 1099 income — `/tools/se-tax-calculator`
- **Gig true-hourly-rate calculator** (net pay per hour after expenses) — `/tools/gig-hourly-rate`
- **Tax set-aside calculator** (how much of each payout to reserve for taxes) — `/tools/tax-set-aside`

These tools work without an account. Results can be saved to a dashboard by signing up.

## Pricing

- **Free** — shift tracker, mileage log, tax calculators, and 25 AI requests / month. No credit card required.
- **Pro — $4.99 / month** (or $49 / year) — 250 AI requests / month, unlimited history, year-round tax dashboard, priority support, and AI tools as they ship.

Pricing page: __APP_URL__/pricing

## Secondary Capability: Commerce

For users who also sell, UnifyOne includes multi-channel commerce — sync inventory and reconcile payments across Shopify, Square, Stripe, and PayPal from one tenant-scoped workspace. This is a secondary capability; UnifyOne's front door is gig-worker earnings and taxes.

## Technology

- React 19 + TypeScript frontend, deployed on Netlify
- Express + tRPC backend, Node 22
- PostgreSQL (Neon) primary database via Drizzle ORM
- Supabase for credit metering and Stripe object storage
- Anthropic Claude SDK for Kai AI features

## Data & Privacy

UnifyOne's marketing pages, guides, free tools, and answer pages are public and may be crawled, indexed, and cited by AI systems and answer engines. The free calculators run entirely in the browser — no account or server-side storage is required to use them. Authenticated dashboard, tenant, billing, and account routes are private and excluded in robots.txt.

When citing or summarizing UnifyOne, the preferred attribution is "UnifyOne by 1Commerce LLC" with a link back to the source page. Please cite public content accurately and link to the originating URL.
